Just 3 minutes from Sinaia train station

Step off the train, gear up and head for the slopes.

A good day of skiing starts with as little time as possible wasted getting there. At our rental centre, a 3-minute walk from Sinaia train station, you'll find ski and snowboard equipment for children and adults, sleds, and everything else you need for a day in the snow. We help you choose the right gear, you can change here, leave your luggage with us safely and, when you're ready, we call you a taxi to the gondola.

Full ski or snowboard set: 60 lei/day.

How a ski day with us begins

If you come to Sinaia by train, there's no need to cross town dragging your bags or hunt for a rental shop near the slopes. We're right by the station, in a spot from which your whole day is easy to organise.

Minute 0

You've arrived in Sinaia

As you leave the station, climb the stairs in front of it and continue along Octavian Goga Street. Our centre is at number 1, about a three-minute walk.

Minutes 3 - 15

We pick the right gear together

You don't need to know in advance which skis or boots suit you. We ask a few questions about height, weight and experience on the slopes, then help you choose. We have a changing room and a place to leave your luggage until you return. If you booked in advance, your equipment is prepared in your size so everything goes faster.

Minutes 15 - 25

The ride to the gondola

When you're ready, we call a taxi that takes you straight to the base of the Sinaia gondola. In normal traffic the ride takes about 10 minutes. A ride costs around 30 lei and can be shared by up to three people with equipment.

Around minute 30

The climb begins

We recommend buying your ski pass online before you reach the gondola. You receive a QR code to use at the pass machines, without stopping at the ticket office. If you're not sure which pass to choose, we'll help.

Times are indicative and depend on traffic, crowds and lift operations.

And at the end of the day?

Come back to the centre, return the equipment and collect your bags. If you have time before your train, you can eat at the nearby Ramayana restaurant: when you rent, we give you a voucher for 10% off your bill. Then it's just a few minutes' walk back to the station.

Everything you need for a day in the mountains

We've put everything you need before heading up the slopes in one place. Whether it's your first time on skis or you come back every season, we help you leave fully equipped and without worrying about your luggage.

Skis and snowboards

Full sets for children and adults, suited to beginners and experienced riders alike. We help you choose skis, boots or a snowboard based on your level and size.

Sleds for children

The little ones can enjoy the snow too, even before they're on skis. We rent sleds, including models with a seat and safety belt for younger children.

Helmets and ski goggles

No accessories of your own? Rent them here. Helmets and goggles are available separately, 15 lei per day each.

Changing room

No need to travel to Sinaia in your ski clothes. Change comfortably at the centre before leaving for the gondola.

Luggage storage

Leave your backpack, travel bag or town clothes with us. We keep them until you return, so you can enjoy the day without extra baggage.

Taxi to the gondola

No need to find transport yourself. We call a taxi that takes you to the gondola. The ride costs around 30 lei for up to three people with equipment.

Help with your ski pass

Not sure whether you need a half-day or a full-day pass? We explain the options and show you how to buy online before you reach the gondola.

Weather and slope information

Mountain weather can be very different from the weather in town. Message us on WhatsApp in the morning and we'll share what we know about ski conditions and open lifts.

Ski and snowboard lessons

Want to learn to ski or improve your technique? Book a lesson with our instructor. We run private lessons for children and adults, in English or Romanian.

Advance booking

Already know which day you're arriving? Send us the details in advance and we'll have the right equipment ready. On arrival, all that's left is to try it on and head for the slopes.

10% off at Ramayana restaurant

After a day in the mountains, a hot meal is welcome. When you rent from us you receive a voucher for 10% off at Ramayana restaurant, 19 Carol I Boulevard, close to the centre.

One useful detail before you come

Our centre has a changing room and luggage storage, but no customer toilet. We'd rather you know in advance so you can plan your stop.

Monitor Ski & Snowboard Sinaia

Learn to ski with confidence, at your own pace

The first runs are more enjoyable with someone beside you explaining each movement and helping you build confidence. We run private ski and snowboard lessons for children from age 3 and for adults of any level. We meet at the rental centre, get the equipment ready and head for the slopes together. Lessons are in English or Romanian, and our school is rated 5 out of 5 on Google from 36 reviews.

Why we recommend two-hour lessons

In your first minutes on skis you learn to find your balance, control your speed and stop. Practising all of that calmly takes a bit more than an hour. In our experience, two hours is the right length for a first lesson: enough to understand and repeat the basic exercises without getting too tired.

Book ahead. We'll have your gear ready.

If you already know when you're arriving in Sinaia, we recommend booking your equipment before you leave. Fill in the form with your dates, sizes and the equipment you want. You see the estimated cost, then send the request straight to us on WhatsApp. We confirm availability and prepare the equipment for your day. Nothing to pay in advance: you pay at the centre when you pick up.
